home.name: João Marcos Martins de Faria Santiago
home.bio: Welcome to my portfolio. I'm a Frontend Developer with a passion for creating beautiful and functional web applications.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Here are some of the projects I've worked on.

projects.title: Project one
projects.description: A small app that taught me layout, components, and clean UI.
projects.longDescription: Project one is a first portfolio piece focused on structure and reuse. I built the main screens, split the UI into components, and practiced keeping the code easy to read. The GitHub repo has the source if you want to look around.

projects.title: Project two
projects.description: A feature-focused build where I worked with forms and page state.
projects.longDescription: Project two goes a bit further than a static page. I wired user actions, handled simple state, and made sure the flow still made sense after a click. The GitHub repo has the source if you want to see how it fits together.

projects.title: Project three
projects.description: A small project about fetching data and showing it clearly.
projects.longDescription: Project three is about taking data from an API and turning it into a readable UI. I focused on loading states, empty results, and keeping the layout consistent. The GitHub repo has the source if you want to follow the data path.

about.title: About
about.body: I’m a frontend developer focused on building clear, accessible interfaces. I work with React and Next.js, and I’m using this site to show what I can do.
